description: Return every transaction (date, description, signed amount, running balance, flags) from statement PDFs, for categorizing, reconciling or entering into accounting software. Money in is positive, money out negative. Uses free monthly pages (statements that don't balance are free; repeats of a file this month are free).

dateOrder.description: Override the detected date order, e.g. DMY for 03/04 = 3 April.

files.description: Absolute paths of statement PDFs on this computer. Several statements from one account can go together.

flipSigns.description: Multiply amounts by -1 (some tools want card charges positive).

password.description: Password for protected PDFs (the same one for every file).

name: get_transactions
title: Get statement transactions
